value.rationale: A central inference issue in the originating model is full-rank parameter learning: its rank condition gives no numerical window-design guarantee. Exact polynomial degradation at a biologically natural endemic fold clarifies this gap, with a universal sixth-power determinant and a fourth-power condition number; these are not arbitrary parameter slices or generic restatements of rank.
